claim: Blood's raised furniture (a roofed sector standing above every neighbour, at most 4,096 across, 512 to 16,960 up) rises a median 6,144 over the campaign (952 pieces; q1 3,072, q3 8,192), and its commonest rise is 8,192, 0.48 of a body (246 pieces; then 2,048 with 128 and 4,096 with 121). E3M1's 36 such pieces rise a median 8,192, 21 of them exactly that. Two-sector pieces rising 0.60-0.97 bodies (median 0.85; 42 pieces, 16 maps), read as altars, biers and tombs, and two-sector pieces in the 0.30-0.48 band (66, 21 maps), read as stalls, are in set-pieces-v1.json. E3M1's saloon wing carries 73 face sprites of its 77.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/consolidation_probe_raised.py over the 43 campaign maps and over E3M1, rerun 2026-11-26

knowledge/blood/design/set-pieces-v1.json (7,014 pieces, campaign plus Death Wish, TEDE and Duke-conversion maps): its classes in rise band 2 all report a median of 0.42-0.48 because the band is 0.30-0.48 bodies; the class names (altar, stall) are our reading, the counts that miner's

tools/mine_venues.py on E3M1's saloon wing (55 sectors): four identical card tables of 1.18M area raised 8,192, and 73 of its 77 sprites face-aligned (knowledge/blood/references/venue-mining.json); the same miner's booth counters in E1M4 rise 4,096-5,120 (venue-patterns.md: counters at 4,096-8,192)
Gravesend's counters at 4,096 read as steps (Gravesend practice)
use: Raise a table or bar 8,192 (half a body); a booth counter may stand 4,096-5,120, which reads as a step from close by. A counter too high to step over must leave a way round it.
